info.title: Wijaya Kusuma LightGBM Internal Inference
info.description: Contract for the user's Colab PKLs. Features are built in Laravel; no customer data or targets are sent. Models use synthetic training transactions.

200.description: All seven models loaded and metadata checks passed.

503.description: At least one model is unavailable; ready=false and errors identify the horizon.

post.description: Atomic batch, 1–500 unique groups. Model is loaded once at startup. Lead time uses the exact 3/7/14/21-day model; projection uses the exact 30/60/90-day model. The forecast_use must match the horizon's metadata. No scaling or interpolation of another horizon.

200.description: One finite nonnegative decimal prediction for every requested group. Echoed identity fields must match the request.

422.description: Invalid schema, version, category encoding, feature set, date, horizon or forecast use. No partial predictions.

503.description: Model not ready or inference failed. Laravel marks the requested forecast unavailable.

as_of_date.description: Completed date before today in Asia/Jakarta.

features.description: Exactly feature_names from metadata_Hd.json in its order. Encoded branch/category IDs, numeric karat, integer sales totals and future calendar counts. Only days_since_last_sale may be null. Calendar feature names end in the requested horizon. Unknown or extra features are rejected.
